title: Harold Malmgren: NHI track the frontier of human innovation

tellings.quote: Why did a presidential adviser named Harold Melmgrren who worked [music] directly with JFK, LBJ, Nixon, and Ford and who was briefed on UFOs, why did [music] he tell me that this is how the nonhuman intelligences operate by tracking the frontier of human innovation?

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, says he spoke with Harold Malmgren, a presidential adviser who worked with Presidents Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon and Ford and who was briefed on UFOs. According to Michels, Malmgren told him that non-human intelligences, meaning beings that are not human, operate by keeping watch on the cutting edge of human invention. If true, our most advanced science would be exactly what these beings are monitoring.
